# Backlog.fyi

> An AI-powered weekly planner: a task backlog plus a planning conversation that turns the tasks
> you agree to into calendar invitations, so they land in your week as real time blocks. Tasks can
> be read and edited from outside the app through a token-authenticated HTTP API.

Task titles and descriptions are encrypted at rest and are private to their owner. Every API
request is authenticated as one specific user and can only reach that user's boards.

## External API

- [Usage guide](https://backlog.fyi/external-api/SKILL.md): how to search, create, update, complete and archive tasks, written for AI assistants. Start here.
- [OpenAPI description](https://backlog.fyi/external-api/openapi.yaml): the full contract — endpoints, schemas and error shapes (OpenAPI 3.1).
- [API catalog](https://backlog.fyi/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset pointing at the above.

Access needs a personal API token, created in the app under Settings -> Integrations and shown
once. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
